mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the average forward return is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over a single month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing the risk of recession and prompting equity investors to reassess corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand momentum, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 over two consecutive months indicates weakening supply-side activity, which may signal an impending slowdown in corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL above 260.0 combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting expectations of delayed rate cuts and higher real interest rates, which depress equity valuations and lead to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal of high CPIAUCSL and elevated FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in GDP growth (GDPC1) from a 6-month low, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates a recovery in aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The combined signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 142,000 over a single month signals labor market weakness, increasing the likelihood of a near-term economic slowdown and triggering risk-off behavior in equity markets, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 540,000 million dollars, coupled with stable industrial production (INDPRO), indicates resilient consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal of high RSAFS and stable INDPRO fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
